title: Health insurance denial rates by insurer, Marketplace plans on HealthCare.gov, 2025

source.name: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, Transparency in Coverage Public Use File, plan year 2027 (2025 data); plan year 2026 file for 2024
source.scope: Individual Marketplace medical plans (QHPs) sold through HealthCare.gov: Federally-facilitated Exchanges, including states that do plan management, and state-based exchanges on the federal platform. Not employer plans, Medicare, Medicaid, or states that run their own exchange (for example California, New York, Minnesota).
source.reported_by: Each insurer reports its own counts to CMS (45 CFR 156.220). CMS: 'Claims denials are not necessarily indicative of issuer strength or plan quality.'

method: One row per insurer per state. Claims denied % = in-network claims denied / in-network claims received, both with dates of service in 2025. Prior authorization denied % = pre-service benefit requests denied / received in 2025 (first published in this file). Appeals won % = internal appeals of claims overturned / filed. Percentages computed by appeal-the-denial from CMS's counts, rounded to 0.1. ** = CMS suppressed a small count; N/A = insurer new to the Exchange, no 2025 data.
